compute_point_mesh_face_distance: compute the squared distance between a batch of pointclouds and meshes using triangular face proximity
compute_point_mesh_edge_distance: compute the squared distance between a batch of pointclouds and meshes using edge segment proximity
compute_point_face_distance: compute the squared distance from each point to the closest triangular face in a mesh batch
compute_face_point_distance: compute the squared distance from each triangular face to the closest point in a pointcloud batch
compute_point_edge_distance: compute the squared distance from each point to the closest edge segment in a mesh batch
